decision: REJECTED: no production edit or new tile/live benchmark justified
scope: Read-only renderer feasibility plus one bounded installed-binding GIL observation
fresh_finding: PySide6 6.11.2 native drawPath prevents heartbeat Python execution for the 4523.50ms single raster call; the sleep control permits 76 strictly interior ticks. This is a local installed-binding fact, not a universal claim about every Qt/PySide version.
current_source_guard: Mature raster reuse requires this engine's owned frame, identity world/device transforms and no painter clipping. Independent tile painters fail these guards. Sharing mutable engine/frame/cache between threads is not justified.
previous_scope: Earlier scratch evidence only; not rerun and not claimed to be current renderer performance
